data.title: dYdX Chain Completes USDC Migration, All USDC Backed by Injective USDC
data.description: The dYdX Foundation said dYdX Chain has completed its USDC migration, with all USDC now backed by Injective USDC. According to Foresight News, user balances and positions remain unchanged, while deposits and withdrawals now go through Injective. A minor display issue on Mintscan has been identified, and the relevant team is working to fix it. The migration follows Circle’s plan to discontinue USDC on Noble and adds a Canonical USDC module; the on-chain token identifier remains unchanged as its backing asset transitions from Noble USDC to Injective USDC.

data.title: STOCKS | South Korean Stocks Rebound Nearly 3% as Expected Stabilization Measures Prompt Dip Buying
data.description:
South Korean stocks rose nearly 3% on Friday as expectations for market-stabilization measures encouraged investors to buy after the index fell close to a 10-month low. According to Odaily, the KOSPI remains on course for a second consecutive weekly decline, after falling 8% the previous week. The index plunged to a 10-month low earlier this week amid concerns that the global AI investment boom could slow, prompting policymakers to consider using a market-stabilization fund.

Kiwoom Securities analyst Han Ji-young said the rebound may be limited until the fund brings in new capital, but that there was no need to take a more pessimistic view. Citi economist Kim Jin-wook said the fund could be expanded from 10.76 trillion won ($8.01 billion) to between 20 trillion and 40 trillion won. Kim expects it could be deployed as early as next month. South Korean Finance Minister Lee Hyeong-il reiterated on Friday that the government was prepared to take necessary measures based on market conditions.

data.title: Tokyo Core CPI Rises to 2.9% YoY; December BoJ Rate Hike Expected
data.description:
According to ChainCatcher citing Reuters, Tokyo's core consumer price index rose 2.9% year over year in November, up from 2.6% in October and below the market median forecast of 3.0%. The index includes fuel prices but excludes fresh food. Its increase was the fastest since July 2025 and the highest in 16 months, keeping inflation above the Bank of Japan's 2% target for a third consecutive month.

An index excluding both fresh food and fuel rose 2.5% year over year in November, down from 2.6% in October. The increase in prices partly reflected the end of government utility subsidies, while food, daily necessities and hotel costs also rose.

Tokyo prices are viewed as a leading indicator of national trends and will be among the factors considered by the Bank of Japan at its two-day policy meeting ending December 18. After raising rates in June, the central bank raised its policy rate to 1.25% in September, then held it steady in October and said underlying inflation was broadly at its 2% target. A majority of analysts in a Reuters survey expected a rate hike in December and another by the end of March next year.

data.title: AI TRENDS | Moonshot AI Opens Applications for Kimi Research Support Program
data.description: Moonshot AI has opened applications for its Kimi Research Support Program. According to Odaily, the first cohort will be open to researchers in the natural sciences, engineering and related interdisciplinary fields. Selected applicants will receive Kimi API credits, technical support from the Kimi team, priority access to new models, and selected research and community resources. Outstanding researchers and teams will receive longer-term technical and resource support.

data.title: zkLink Nova Service Restored, Withdrawals to Some Networks Still Paused
data.description: zkLink Nova service has been restored, allowing users to withdraw assets to Arbitrum, Linea, zkSync, Scroll and Manta. According to Foresight News, withdrawals to Ethereum, Optimism, Mantle and Base remain paused. Cross-chain contracts on those networks were attacked in an earlier security incident, and the affected assets are under investigation.

data.title: Nasdaq 100’s Five-Day Average Intraday Volatility Hits 3.8%, Highest Since April 2025
data.description:
The Nasdaq 100’s average intraday range over the past five trading days reached 3.8%, its highest since April 2025 and the second-highest since the 2022 bear market. According to Odaily, The Kobeissi Letter said the figure was surpassed only by a 4.0% peak during that bear market. The index’s intraday range was 4.2% on Wednesday and 5.7% last Friday, its widest single-day range since April 9, 2025.

During the COVID-19 pandemic in 2020 and the 2008 financial crisis, the Nasdaq 100’s five-day average intraday range peaked at 7.7% and 8.9%, respectively. The indicator reached 10.2% in January 2001 after the dot-com bubble burst. The Kobeissi Letter said volatility in technology stocks is currently at a historically high level.

data.title: Devere CEO Nigel Green Says Bitcoin Could Rebound Strongly if AI Stocks Recover
data.description:
According to ChainCatcher citing Bitcoin.com, Devere Group CEO Nigel Green said Bitcoin could be among the first assets to rebound if investor confidence in AI stocks recovers. He expects Bitcoin to move closely with chip stocks over the coming weeks and said its performance is currently heavily constrained by the Nasdaq.

Green said Bitcoin is held in the same portfolios and risk systems as major AI stocks. When funds need to cut exposure quickly, they sell the most liquid assets and those that have risen the most; he said Bitcoin meets both criteria. He added that chipmakers’ earnings, demand for AI computing power and Federal Reserve interest rate decisions are likely to affect Bitcoin more over the coming weeks than developments in its own network. Green reiterated that Bitcoin could be among the first assets to benefit as confidence in AI rebuilds.

data.title: World Gold Council: Chinese Investors Can Adopt a Two-Tier Gold Allocation Strategy
data.description:
The World Gold Council released a report on gold allocations across different economic cycles in China. According to Odaily, the report recommends a two-tier strategy: maintain a strategic allocation to gold to capture returns across economic cycles and diversify risk, while dynamically adjusting holdings based on the cycle. This approach can allow gold to contribute returns in favorable conditions and provide greater diversification and downside protection when needed.

The council backtested a simulated long-term Chinese portfolio comprising 35% stocks, 55% bonds and 10% cash. The results showed that raising gold’s allocation to 16% and proportionally reducing the weights of other assets produced the greatest marginal improvement in the portfolio’s Sharpe ratio.

data.title: ArcBlock Urges Blocklet Server Users to Update and Avoid Running as Root
data.description: ArcBlock urged users running their own Blocklet servers to update to the latest version and avoid running them under a root account. According to Foresight News, the project also advised users to enable activity notifications and audit logs, review logs and permissions, and, if a server is suspected of being compromised, isolate it, rotate credentials and consider rebuilding it from a clean state.

data.title: Morpho's Largest EURCV Vault Liquidity Trails the Largest Address's Position by About 13.8 Million EURCV
data.description:
According to ChainCatcher citing CryptoSlate, as of November 26, Morpho's largest EUR CoinVertible (EURCV) vault, Steakhouse Prime, held about 144.35 million EURCV and showed available liquidity of about 107.22 million. The largest address held about 120.99 million EURCV, or 83.8% of the vault's deposits. If the address had fully withdrawn at that time, the displayed liquidity would have fallen about 13.77 million EURCV short of its position.

On-chain data from the same day showed a regular withdrawal limit of about 103.13 million EURCV for the address's position, about 17.86 million below its holdings. When vault settings allow, Morpho can draw available funds from other markets; the amount that can actually be withdrawn depends on liquidity at the time of execution.

The European Banking Authority said in a November 25 report that its July analysis found more than half of the circulating EURCV supply deposited in Morpho vaults.
